production.note: US model years. First: MBUSA pricing release: "The highly anticipated 2022 Mercedes-AMG SL represents the rebirth of an icon"; the SL 'will arrive in U.S. dealerships in the summer'. Still on sale: mbusa.com lists the 2027 AMG SL 63 Roadster (mbusa-2027-sl63). The SL 63 S E PERFORMANCE plug-in hybrid is a separate variant and not part of this record.

body.note: Sold as the 'AMG SL 63 Roadster', a soft-top open car with no fixed-roof version; mbusa.com lists 4 seats (2+2).

displacementL.note: 3,982 cc (Auto Bild technical data: 'Hubraum (cm³) 3982'); MBUSA states '4.0L'.

fuel.note: Inferred from the description of the V8 biturbo engine.

transmission.note: 'AMG SPEEDSHIFT® MCT 9-speed', recorded as Automatic as in the other AMG MCT records.

powerHp.note: Quote (mbusa.com, 2027 model): "577 hp @ 5,500-6,500 rpm". Same rating at launch, MBUSA 2022 pricing release (mbusa-sl-pricing-2022): "The powertrain in the AMG SL 63 develops 577 hp and delivers 590 lb-ft of torque". European rating 585 PS (Auto Bild: '430 (585)/5500').

weightLb.note: US curb weight, 2027 model, 9-speed MCT (the only transmission). Quote (mbusa.com): "Curb weight 4,376 lbs"; no estimate label. No MBUSA weight for an earlier model year was found (the 2022 pricing release gives none), so the reference year is 2027, the earliest year with a qualifying weight under the 577 hp rating (unchanged since 2022). Mercedes-Benz Canada lists '1,970 kg' (4,343 lb) for its 2026 car, a different market and year (mbca-2026-sl63).

sources.title: Mercedes-Benz USA announces pricing and curated trims for all-new Mercedes-AMG SL
